purpose: Test whether a longer training budget for the existing 184-field v11 residual expert gives a reproducible capacity gain without changing inputs, weight, route, or the sealed local v9 missing-clock policy.

scope.source_family: v11 184-field CatBoost GPU residual to own valid AOBT proxy
scope.training_labels: Finite 2025 taxi targets in [0,86400] with finite own AOBT proxy in [0,7200].
scope.heldout_scoring_labels: All finite targets on the exact heldout valid-AOBT IDs; original all-finite fold policy also preserves every invalid-proxy v9 prediction.
scope.internal_early_stop: Complementary months only; RNG seed 2026 permutation, first max(20000, floor(0.06 * eligible_count)) eligible rows for early stopping, remaining eligible rows for fit, patience 200, use_best_model true.
scope.saved_model_prefix: Exactly the first 10000 trees of the same saved 20000-budget model, predicted with ntree_end=10000. A saved model with tree_count <= 10000 is terminally ineligible; no separately trained prefix or replacement variant is tried.

frozen_reference.v11_10000_budget_original_oof: artifacts/v11-taxi-flow-expert/<fold>_oof.parquet expert values, exact original-fold valid-AOBT IDs
frozen_reference.v11_10000_budget_fresh_oof: artifacts/v11-taxi-flow-expert/fresh_new/fresh_apr_oct_oof.parquet expert values, exact fresh valid-AOBT IDs
frozen_reference.v11_saved_ranking_raw: artifacts/later-feature-final/ranking_expert.parquet raw_expert on the same exact 339377 valid-AOBT ranking IDs

bootstrap.gain_direction: RMSE of comparator minus RMSE of candidate
bootstrap.confidence_interval: empirical 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of paired day resamples

original_folds.fit_and_early_stop: Exclude both heldout months from both fit and early stop for each fold.
original_folds.old_raw: Sealed original v11 10000-tree expert prediction aligned by exact movement ID.
original_folds.full_raw: Saved v13 model prediction from its complete best-model tree count.
original_folds.prefix_raw: Prediction from the same saved v13 model with ntree_end=10000.
original_folds.outside_valid_aobt: Copy sealed v9 selected predictions exactly.
original_folds.coverage: Exact 672428 all-finite original heldout movement IDs, with exact target, UTC time, fold, and valid-proxy flags. Full and prefix experts cover every valid-proxy heldout ID only; no row exceptions or ID-based predictors.
original_folds.gate: On each original fold, fixed full candidate improves all-finite RMSE over v9 and its paired UTC-day lower gain bound is >0. The full candidate also improves RMSE over its own 10000-tree prefix candidate with positive paired UTC-day lower gain bound. Saved full model tree_count must exceed 10000. Failure is terminal for this capacity route; no weight or budget is reselected.

fresh_april_october.fit_and_early_stop: Both April and October excluded from both fit and early stop.
fresh_april_october.matched_baseline: Sealed v11 fresh_audit_predictions.v11_blend, aligned by exact movement ID, target, and UTC time.
fresh_april_october.matched_old_raw: Sealed v11 fresh_new/fresh_apr_oct_oof.expert on the same IDs.
fresh_april_october.gate: For both months separately, full candidate RMSE improves over matched v11_blend; pooled paired UTC-day 95 percent lower gain bound is >0. Full candidate also improves over its own 10000-tree prefix candidate by both-month RMSE and positive pooled paired UTC-day lower bound; saved model tree_count must exceed 10000. No further fresh variants follow failure.

promotion_branch_after_v12_terminal.decision_order: Resolve all v12 original, fresh April/October, and separate February/August gates before choosing the v13 compatibility comparator. Do not use v12 intermediate scores to change the v13 formula, weight, budget, or validation dates.

if_v12_fails_any_required_gate.compatibility_comparator: sealed local v9 original-fold and matched April/October policies
if_v12_fails_any_required_gate.promotion: v13 must pass its own original, fresh, and February/August gates; otherwise retain local v9

if_v12_passes_all_required_gates.geometry_original_comparator: artifacts/v12-runway-geometry-expert/validation_predictions.parquet candidate values on exact all-finite original-fold IDs
if_v12_passes_all_required_gates.geometry_fresh_comparator: artifacts/v12-runway-geometry-expert/fresh_audit_predictions.parquet v12_blend values on exact 357813 fresh valid-AOBT IDs
if_v12_passes_all_required_gates.comparison_formula_stays_fixed: v13 remains clip(v9_selected + 0.5 * (long184 - old_v11_raw), lower=0) on original valid-AOBT rows and the corresponding matched v11_blend/old_v11_fresh_raw formula on April/October; it never merges geometry features or changes weight based on v12 results.
if_v12_passes_all_required_gates.compatibility_gate: v13 candidate improves all-finite RMSE over validated geometry policy with positive paired UTC-day lower gain bound on each original fold; on matched April/October IDs it improves RMSE over geometry in each month and has positive pooled paired UTC-day lower gain bound. Exact movement ID, target, UTC time, and scoring masks must agree before scores are computed.
if_v12_passes_all_required_gates.promotion: Only v13 passing original, fresh, geometry compatibility, and February/August gates can replace geometry; otherwise retain validated geometry.

promotion_branch_after_v12_terminal.failure_policy: One terminal choice only. No alternate weight, budget, feature merge, selected airport, or row exception after observing a failed gate.

separate_february_august_component_guard.execution: Only after original/fresh gates and conditional geometry compatibility pass, freeze source/input/model/report hashes before either v13 February/August guard refit or v13 guard scoring. This 2025 window was already inspected by the separate v12 guard and is not untouched test data.
separate_february_august_component_guard.comparator: New 10000-budget pure v11 184-field residual model excluding February/August from fit and early stop.
separate_february_august_component_guard.replacement: New 20000-budget v13 184-field residual model excluding February/August from fit and early stop.
separate_february_august_component_guard.matched_requirements: Identical fit IDs, early-stop IDs, all-finite valid-AOBT heldout IDs, targets, UTC times, 184 feature names/order/dtypes, and all 24 ordered categorical vocabularies. Only maximum iteration budget differs.
separate_february_august_component_guard.gate: Saved 20000-budget model tree_count >10000; fixed full component improves over clipped pure old_10000 in each month and pooled paired UTC-day lower gain bound >0; fixed full component also improves over its own prefix formula in each month with positive pooled paired UTC-day lower bound. Otherwise retain the policy selected before v13; no refit, alternate weight, or ranking output.

original_terminal: validation.json: frozen fixed-weight gates, original model/OOF/receipt hashes, exact coverage and bootstrap results
fresh_terminal: fresh_audit.json: fixed-weight gate, exact coverage, source/model/OOF/receipt hashes and bootstrap results
planned_artifact_contract.compatibility: A separate immutable compatibility protocol must seal the resolved v12 terminal status, selected comparator artifacts and exact source/report hashes before reading geometry comparison labels or scoring. Its output must bind aligned original/fresh paired predictions, metric replay, and terminal route.
planned_artifact_contract.february_august: A separate immutable matched guard protocol must seal the promoted route, source/input hashes and fixed weight before v13 guard refits or v13 guard scoring. Both model receipts must bind exact fit/early/held IDs, 184-field schema, ordered category vocabularies, model/OOF/report hashes and prefix tree count; this window was previously inspected for v12 and cannot be claimed as untouched.
planned_artifact_contract.final: A separate guarded final extension may fit and predict only after all terminal reports and source hashes are verified; the original v13 source final modes must refuse until then.

final_if_all_gates_pass.training: Fit the exact 184-field model on all eligible 2025 labels. Use only the integer median of the two ORIGINAL v13 Jan/July and November/December saved tree counts; never use fresh, compatibility, or February/August tree counts to set final iterations.
final_if_all_gates_pass.ranking_reference: Sealed local v9 submission and matching saved v11 raw ranking expert; exact template ID/order of 344841 rows.
final_if_all_gates_pass.outside_valid_formula: Copy sealed local v9 values exactly, including all missing-clock corrections.
final_if_all_gates_pass.output: Local complete finite nonnegative Parquet in template ID order, with exclusive model/ranking artifacts and aggregate receipts only. No upload or finalizer in the comparison source.

provenance_and_interpretation.freeze_before_each_phase: Exact source/helper/spec SHA256, raw training and 2026 ranking source SHA256, feature cache and builder receipts, reference OOF/report/model SHA256, fixed policy/guard receipts, target-free ranking template, 184 feature schema and 24 categorical vocabularies. Rehash before and after each feature load, fit, evaluation, and artifact write; exclusive outputs and readback checks.
provenance_and_interpretation.required_artifact_identity: Every paired evaluation uses exact unique movement ID sets and aligned target/UTC time; reports seal model, OOF, fit report, source and protocol hashes, fit/early/held ID hashes, original tree counts, candidate formula, bootstrap seed and result.
provenance_and_interpretation.statistical_limit: All 2025 windows have been inspected repeatedly. These paired date-block checks support a constrained model-change decision, not an untouched estimate of future performance or a guarantee of first place.
